name: Cell Sleep Energy Saver
use_case: O-RAN UC21 cell switch on/off energy saving
description: Cell Sleep Energy Saver rApp (O-RAN UC21 cell switch on/off energy saving). Ranks lightly loaded cells or carriers for sleep, switches them off and restores them when load returns (writes cell_power). Use when the goal is to cut RAN energy consumption by switching cells or carriers off in low-traffic periods, or to bring sleeping cells back. Do not use when capacity has to be added, coverage reshaped or individual users prioritised; declared conflict with capacity-boost functions. Emulated rApp served by rapps/runtime.py: decisions are simple estimators over live KPM; apply tools write an A1-style policy document that is not enforced on the RAN.

tools.description: Rank cells for deep sleep from PRB utilisation.

tools.label: Apply Cell Sleep
tools.description: Switch the selected cells off via RC and confirm.
